app.title: GCC AI Governance Kit
app.tagline: Adopt AI governance in one afternoon.
app.intro: Register an AI use case, get an explainable risk tier, and export the controls that apply under the frameworks you follow. Everything stays in your browser.
lang.toggle.label: Switch to Arabic
nf.title: Page not found
footer.privacy: Your data never leaves this browser.
store.unavailable: Your browser is blocking storage, so changes will be lost when you close the page. Export your register to keep it.
reg.caption: AI use-case register
reg.name: Use case
reg.empty: Your register is empty. Add your first AI use case, or load two examples to see how it works.
reg.confirm.delete: Delete this use case? This cannot be undone.
reg.confirm.clear: Delete every use case in this browser? Export first if you want a copy.
reg.import.replace: Replace your current register with the imported file? Choose Cancel to merge instead.
reg.import.bad: That file is not a register exported from this kit.
uc.name: Name
deep.intro: Ten more questions for a fuller picture. Answers here can only raise the tier.
tier.title: Risk tier
tier.question: Question
tier.deep.offer: Complete the deep-dive (about 5 minutes) for a fuller control list.
tier.deep.strong: This use case is high risk. Complete the deep-dive before it goes to committee.
ctl.intro: Controls that apply to this use case under your selected frameworks.
ctl.nofw: Select at least one framework on the register page to see controls.
ctl.unacceptable: This use case falls into a prohibited category. Do not proceed; controls cannot make it acceptable. Escalate to your risk committee and legal team.
exp.intro: Take the result into your organisation.
exp.pdf.hint: The committee report opens your print dialog. Choose "Save as PDF".
rep.title: AI Use-Case Risk Summary
rep.disclaimer: Guidance only, not legal advice. Check obligations with your legal and compliance teams.
sc.intro: The tier is the higher of two results: the points from your answers, and any rule that sets a minimum tier. Nothing is hidden: every weight is listed below.
sc.triggers: Rules that set a minimum tier
sc.deep.rule: Deep-dive answers are added to the quick-check points. They can raise the tier but never lower it.
ab.intro: Each control links to one or more framework references and to the official sources used to check it. Rows that have not yet been checked are clearly labelled.
ab.verified: controls are verified against their cited sources.
ab.src.uae: UAE Charter for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence (2024)
ab.src.dubai: Dubai AI Ethics Principles and Guidelines
ab.iso: a paid, copyrighted standard. This kit cites clause and Annex A numbers only and paraphrases in its own words.
ab.privacy: This site has no backend. What you enter is stored only in this browser and is never sent anywhere.

tpl.intro: Use the templates on their own, in any spreadsheet tool. Field names match the app, so data moves between them.
